page: Microsoft Azure M128-64bds_v3 is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the MBDSMediumMemoryv3 family. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 32 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8473C processor running at 4.0 GHz. The processor includes a 105 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX). The server is equipped with 1024.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 16.0 GB per core. Local storage consists of a 410 GB disk, and the instance is Premium Storage capable.

In benchmark evaluations, the M128-64bds_v3 demonstrates strong multi-core processing capabilities, placing in the top 25% for stress-ng multi-core and Passmark CPU tests. Memory performance is notable, with uncached large-block read-only memory bandwidth reaching the top 10% tier at 366.27 GB/sec. Database operations on Passmark also rank in the top 10% tier, supported by strong Redis SET throughput of 87.07 million operations per second. Single-core performance is mixed, with Geekbench single-core scoring in the top 10% while stress-ng single-core falls into the middle 50% average.

This server is configured for memory-intensive workloads that require substantial RAM capacity relative to compute resources, such as large-scale database hosting, in-memory caching, and data analytics. The inclusion of Intel AMX instructions supports CPU-based machine learning workloads, as reflected in strong prompt processing speeds for 7B and 70B LLM models. The high memory density and dedicated CPU allocation provide a stable environment for enterprise applications, though the lack of a dedicated GPU limits its efficiency for heavy parallel deep learning training.
